name: @pipeworx/mcp-form5500

tools.name: form5500_search
tools.description: Search U.S. Department of Labor Form 5500 / 5500-SF filings (employee benefit & pension plans, EFAST2) by plan sponsor name, employer EIN, plan name, state, and/or plan year. Returns matching filings with sponsor, plan name/number, participant counts, plan assets, plan type, and a link to the filing PDF. Provide at least one of sponsor, ein, plan_name, or state.

sponsor.description: Plan sponsor / employer name (e.g. "Apple Inc", "Microsoft"). Partial/phrase match.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (9 digits, dashes optional). Exact match.

plan_name.description: Plan name (e.g. "401(k) Profit Sharing Plan"). Partial/phrase match.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state code of the sponsor (e.g. "CA", "NY").

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-200, default 20).

sort.description: Sort order. One of: "datereceived desc" (default), "datereceived asc", "planyear desc", "planyear asc", "assetseoy desc", "participantsboy desc".

tools.name: form5500_filing
tools.description: Get Form 5500 filing detail from the DOL EFAST2 index. Pass ack_id for a single filing (sponsor, plan name/number, participant counts, begin/end-of-year plan assets, plan type, filing date, and full filing PDF URL). Pass ein instead to get a plan sponsor's full filing history (all Form 5500 filings for that EIN, newest first). Note: line-item detail such as Schedule C service providers is not in the search index — the returned pdf_url links to the complete filing.

ack_id.description: EFAST2 Acknowledgement ID (the 30-char filing id, e.g. "20230407122300NAL0001820321001"). Returns one filing.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (9 digits, dashes optional). Returns the full filing history for that employer.

limit.description: For ein history: max filings to return (1-200, default 50).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-form5500 forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the form5500 pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
